in_marathi.name: Anilaabh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wind, Air, God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anilaabh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anilaabh is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Anila' meaning wind or air and 'Abh' meaning god. This name is associated with the god of wind, Vayu, and evokes images of strength, freedom, and power. In Hindu mythology, Vayu is believed to control all forms of wind and is an essential element for life.
